statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit across homepage, listing, track detail, playlist, authentication, and error-state paths.

page.notes: Persian RTL public music catalogue with server-rendered archive/detail pages, direct audio downloads, and account entry.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated light and dark preference screenshots plus computed-style probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Light preference produces a light surface and dark preference produces a dark surface; both remain usable.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared normal and reduced-motion animation probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: Three 300 ms animations exist normally; under reduce, getAnimations() returned none and scroll behavior remained auto.
Forced-colors mode mapped links to yellow, text to white, and surfaces to black with visible borders and controls.
No View Transition declarations were found for this multi-page site.
No scroll-linked effects or scroll-handler-driven animation were observed; therefore no main-thread scroll animation anti-pattern is present.
Horizontal content rows use native scrolling with scroll-snap declarations, and no custom pointer-driven gesture was required for the core flow.
The homepage is 18,490 px tall and has no scroll-state-aware chrome or progress indicator.
No tooltip, anchored popover, or edge-sensitive menu is part of the representative paths, so anchor positioning has no applicable target.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip, anchored popover, or edge-sensitive menu is part of the representative paths, so anchor positioning has no applicable target.

checkOutcomes.method: Detail flow DOM and screenshot review
checkOutcomes.evidence: Breadcrumbs, a named jump link to #ms, and descriptive download controls guide users from the track heading to the primary action.
No popup or interstitial obscures content on load; primary content begins immediately.
The transient homepage search UI uses a native dialog; no ad-hoc modal was present on audited paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Visual review across representative mobile pages
checkOutcomes.evidence: Chrome is limited to compact navigation/search and content cards; the music and download content dominates each path.

checkOutcomes.method: 360×800 layout metrics on home and detail
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both templates report scrollWidth=clientWidth=360, zero horizontal overflow, and a valid viewport meta tag.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered CSS inspection and representative screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: Rendered CSS contains @container/container-type and cards reflow across desktop and mobile captures.
Focus outlines are present, but several key controls measure below comfortable touch size.
The site purpose, search, categories, track names, and detail-page download intent are explicit in Persian.
A listing leads to a detail page with a jump link, playable audio, and direct 320/128/64 kbps MP3 links.
A nonexistent path redirects to the homepage with no error state or explanation.
Lighthouse LCP is 7.1 s and performance is 0.66; CLS is 0 and TBT is 80 ms.
Home and detail observed CLS=0 with no shifts; Lighthouse also reports CLS 0.
Trace TBT is 40 ms with one 90 ms long task; Lighthouse TBT is 80 ms, both indicating a light main thread.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR, DOM confirmation, and Lighthouse diagnostics
checkOutcomes.evidence: Ten parser-inserted high-priority stylesheets and weak image caching create avoidable delivery cost.
Only 66.8 KB of scripts transferred and Lighthouse did not flag large unused/duplicate JavaScript; the only minification saving was about 3 KiB CSS.

checkOutcomes.method: Images primitive, DOM probe, and Lighthouse
checkOutcomes.evidence: Twenty-six images lack alt text, search is unlabeled, and the detail template contains many unnamed links.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse contrast audit and theme screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse fails the color-contrast audit and muted search text is visibly faint.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse structure audits and focus probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Focus is visible, but the homepage has no main landmark and H1 follows several H2s.
Body and heading text are unclipped and comfortably spaced in RTL layouts on audited mobile pages.
Scaling is permitted and pages reflow, but several core targets are below 44×44 px.
Lighthouse best-practices score is 1.0 and errors-in-console passed.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM, image, and Lighthouse best-practices audits
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTML has doctype/UTF-8; images reserve dimensions, aspect ratio audits pass, and Lighthouse best practices scores 1.0.
No deprecated API, inspector, prompt-on-load, vulnerable-library, paste-prevention, or BFCache failure was reported.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM probes across home and detail
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both representative pages expose unique descriptive titles and meta descriptions.
Links use real hrefs, viewport meta is present, robots permits public content, and Lighthouse SEO is 1.0.
Pages return 200, canonical URLs and index/follow metadata are present, and robots.txt points to a populated sitemap index.
Home and track detail contain JSON-LD plus accurate Open Graph title, description, URL, and image/audio metadata.
HTTPS/HSTS are present and no secrets were found, but CSP is absent and five cookies lack Secure.
Legacy Google Analytics sets persistent __utm identifiers, including a 400-day cookie.

checkOutcomes.method: Load behavior and authentication surface probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permission prompt occurs on load; sign-in offers OTP and Google identity rather than requiring a password alone.
HSTS, nosniff, SAMEORIGIN and Referrer-Policy are present, but Permissions-Policy and CSP are absent.

checkOutcomes.method: No-JS discoverability on home and detail
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw HTML preserves 100% reported content coverage, titles, H1s and descriptions on both core templates.

checkOutcomes.method: Representative path screenshots and runtime probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: Search/dialog, content rows, audio and download controls render without clipping or broken async state on audited paths.
This is a public music/download content MPA rather than an installed application; a service worker exists, but installability is not required for its core task.
checkOutcomes.reason: This is a public music/download content MPA rather than an installed application; a service worker exists, but installability is not required for its core task.

checkOutcomes.evidence: A nonexistent URL redirects to an ordinary homepage and does not expose a truthful, recoverable 404 state.
The document uses lang=fa-IR and dir=rtl; rendered CSS includes logical inline properties and RTL layouts are correct.
The track page presents Persian month/year and RTL-localized date/time content rather than raw machine timestamps.
Audited music pages do not coordinate cross-zone events, recurring schedules, or user-entered times, so time-zone/DST handling is not applicable.
checkOutcomes.reason: Audited music pages do not coordinate cross-zone events, recurring schedules, or user-entered times, so time-zone/DST handling is not applicable.

checkOutcomes.method: Homepage, detail, playlist, and auth visual review
checkOutcomes.evidence: No confirmshaming, forced continuity, disguised ad control, autoplay, or consent wall appeared; registration is optional.
The sign-in UI uses native required-field validation and clear labels; the visible mobile-number step is simple and reversible.
Telephone, password and email fields omit relevant autocomplete tokens; only OTP fields use one-time-code.
The account entry clearly offers mobile/email, one-time code and Google sign-in without hidden pricing, continuity, or purchase commitment.
All 100 audited images use legacy formats; four are oversized and images transfer 1.37 MB.
Script transfer is 66.8 KB, TBT is 40–80 ms, no autoplay media exists, and no wasteful background loop was observed.
Third-party analytics transfers about 18 KB, media does not autoplay, and audio uses preload=none; most subdomain bytes directly serve content images/audio.
The public music catalogue has no declared agent-facing transaction/tool surface; WebMCP absence is an opportunity, not a failure.
checkOutcomes.reason: The public music catalogue has no declared agent-facing transaction/tool surface; WebMCP absence is an opportunity, not a failure.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited search/download experience has no inference task that requires an on-device language model or summarizer.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited search/download experience has no inference task that requires an on-device language model or summarizer.

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline/post heap summaries and repeated search open/close metrics
checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten search open/close cycles, DOM nodes were unchanged and JS heap moved only 13 KB; snapshot totals rose about 1.8% with no constructor accumulation.
Baseline heap self-size is 9.64 MB for a content-heavy page with 1,436 DOM elements, proportionate to the page.

checkOutcomes.method: Before/after heap constructor comparison and DOM count
checkOutcomes.evidence: Neither heap summary reports Detached* constructors; constructor counts remain stable and DOM node count does not grow after repeated interaction.

principleOutcomes.reason: The public music catalogue has no declared agent-facing transaction/tool surface; WebMCP absence is an opportunity, not a failure. The audited search/download experience has no inference task that requires an on-device language model or summarizer.

paths.description: Homepage and global shell: entry point, navigation, search, themes, performance, accessibility, privacy and long-page behavior.
Single-track archive template representing category/list pages and discovery into a track.
Current track detail representing playback, lyrics, jump navigation and direct 320/128/64 kbps download flow.
Playlist detail representing long-form collection/media content.
Account entry reached from the homepage, representing sign-in, OTP and input-assistance behavior.
Deliberately unknown route used to assess HTTP failure state and recovery.

findings.summary: Page-to-page changes are abrupt because cross-document View Transitions are not enabled.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection across the MPA found no @view-transition or view-transition-name declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } and stable view-transition-name values for persistent page elements, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll-state-aware header or progress feedback.
findings.evidence: The mobile homepage is 18,490 CSS px tall, while DOM/CSS inspection found no scroll-state query or progress indicator.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a sticky header with a scroll-state container query or add a lightweight declarative scroll progress indicator.

findings.summary: Several navigation and search controls are too small for comfortable touch use.
findings.evidence: The evaluate probe measured the Search button at 20×20 px and multiple navigation links at about 22–23×31 px; the detail template has several 19 px-high links.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive hit areas to at least 44×44 CSS px through padding while retaining the visible focus treatment.

findings.summary: Unknown URLs silently redirect to the homepage instead of showing a clear not-found state.
findings.evidence: A request to a deliberately nonexistent path returned HTTP 301 to the homepage; the resulting title and H1 are the normal homepage and provide no not-found explanation or recovery context.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a true 404 response with a concise Persian not-found message, search, home link, and relevant category links.

findings.summary: Mobile Largest Contentful Paint is well outside the good range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 7.1 s, FCP at 2.9 s, Speed Index at 6.2 s, and performance 0.66; the independent trace measured LCP at 1.95 s under a less constrained run.
findings.suggestedFix: Identify the LCP image, make it discoverable in initial HTML, use fetchpriority="high" only for that image, and avoid lazy-loading it.

findings.summary: Image caching and render-blocking CSS leave substantial delivery savings.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 74 requests and 1.65 MB transferred, ten parser-inserted very-high-priority stylesheets, and many image responses without useful cache headers; Lighthouse estimated 1,135 KiB cache savings and 250 ms render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Cache versioned images for a long lifetime, remove page-irrelevant plugin CSS, inline only critical CSS, and load the rest without blocking first render.

findings.summary: Search, imagery, and many detail-page links lack usable accessible names.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 26 images without alt text; the home search input has no label; the detail probe counted 172 links without discernible text.
findings.suggestedFix: Label search explicitly, add meaningful alt text or empty alt for decorative images, and give icon/image-only links an accessible name.

findings.summary: Some foreground/background combinations fail WCAG contrast minimums.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility audit failed color-contrast; the disabled-looking search placeholder is visibly low contrast in both themes.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust muted text and placeholder tokens to meet at least 4.5:1 for normal text and retest both themes.

findings.summary: The homepage lacks a main landmark and uses a non-sequential heading hierarchy.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed heading-order and landmark-one-main; the probe found zero main landmarks and places the H1 after five H2 headings.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in <main>, place the page H1 before section H2s, and keep footer headings within a logical hierarchy.

findings.summary: Touch-target sizing weakens usability under mobile reflow.
findings.evidence: Although 360 px layouts have no horizontal overflow and user scaling is allowed, measured search/navigation targets fall well below 44×44 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Expand target hit boxes with padding and verify at 200% zoom and 320–360 px widths.

findings.summary: The site lacks a Content Security Policy and sets analytics cookies without Secure or an explicit same-site posture.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive found no CSP; cookies primitive found five __utm* cookies without Secure and reported SameSite=None, including one retained for 400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive report-only CSP before enforcing it, mark HTTPS cookies Secure, and use Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: Legacy Google Analytics tracking creates persistent identifiers without visible minimisation evidence.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found ssl.google-analytics.com and www.google-analytics.com; five legacy __utm* cookies are set, one for 400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace legacy session-wide analytics with consent-aware, data-minimised measurement and shorten identifier retention.

findings.summary: Permissions-Policy is absent, leaving browser capabilities unrestricted by response policy.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence confirms HSTS, nosniff, SAMEORIGIN, and Referrer-Policy, but no Permissions-Policy header and no CSP frame-ancestors policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a least-privilege Permissions-Policy and migrate clickjacking control into CSP frame-ancestors while retaining X-Frame-Options for compatibility.

findings.summary: HTTP not-found handling produces a misleading success-like homepage state.
findings.evidence: The nonexistent path redirects with 301 to a normal 200 homepage instead of preserving the failed URL with an actionable 404 state.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve intentional 404/5xx templates with correct status codes, clear state, retry/search options, and navigation back to useful content.

findings.summary: Sign-in fields omit key autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: The auth probe found the visible telephone field with no autocomplete token and password/email fields without username/current-password/email tokens; OTP fields correctly use one-time-code.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply tel/username, email, current-password/new-password, and one-time-code autocomplete tokens to the corresponding fields.

findings.summary: The homepage ships only legacy image formats and several oversized images.
findings.evidence: Images primitive scanned 100 images: 100 JPG/PNG/GIF and zero AVIF/WebP, four oversized images, and six without responsive srcset; images account for 1.37 MB of 1.65 MB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, ensure srcset/sizes match rendered card widths, and keep JPEG as fallback only where needed.

taskList.title: Return truthful, recoverable HTTP error states
Fix accessible names, labels, landmarks, headings and contrast
Improve LCP, image caching and critical resource delivery
Deploy CSP and least-privilege browser policies; secure cookies
Increase mobile touch target hit areas
Minimise legacy analytics identifiers and retention
Add cross-document transitions and scroll-aware guidance
